summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13.23 streaming replication with node1 as writable primary and node2/node3 as read-only standbys. Replication uses a persistent encrypted 10.77.0.0/24 database overlay; PostgreSQL is absent from management addresses. All nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created and firewalled a persistent WireGuard database network.
Configured node-generated certificates and TLS-authenticated replication.
Created two active physical replication slots on node1.
Initialized node2 and node3 from online base backups and enabled hot standby mode.
Verified committed data on both standbys and confirmed writes are rejected.
Restarted node2, node3, and node1 individually, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Writable primary and two read-only streaming standbys
evidence.summary: node1 is writable and outside recovery; both standbys are streaming, in recovery, read-only, fully caught up, and reject updates.

evidence.requirement: Committed changes replicate to both standbys
evidence.summary: A post-restart commit on node1 was replayed as row 2 on both node2 and node3.

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL traffic stays off the management network
evidence.summary: All listeners and live replication sockets use 10.77.0.x via wgdb0; no management-IP listener exists and public-zone TCP/5432 is closed.
Healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot UUID, and recovery as writable primary with both standbys streaming.
